decisive_items: Long T1 and T2 signals with severe edema, circular enhancement on contrast-enhanced T1 sequence
response.rationale: Brain lesion pathology directly identifies fungal hyphae, making cerebral aspergillosis the most specific diagnosis. R4 invasive aspergillosis is broader and supported by similar evidence but lacks the brain-specific localization.

rejected.why: Lung-focused; ignores central nervous system findings and fungal hyphae in brain.
Imaging mimics malignancy but lung biopsy shows inflammation, not tumor cells; brain pathology shows fungal hyphae.
CSF pleocytosis and ring enhancement are nonspecific; brain pathology excludes simple abscess.
